_comment: Guided tour for the TTTR time-window tool. Steps point at real controls; the ones the user must use wait for them.

steps.title: Choose the window duration
steps.text: The duration in milliseconds. Short windows give many windows with few photons each; the dashed lines in the preview follow the value (they are left out when they would be too dense to tell apart).

await.hint: Change the Time window (ms) value and press Enter.

steps.title: Queue the files
steps.text: Each queued TTTR file is cut into consecutive windows of equal duration. Press Load example to generate a deterministic demonstration measurement (a µs-ALEX stream with bursts) in the settings cache and queue it. Files (or dropping files or a folder on the window) queues real data; Folder and Database queue whole sets. Click a queued file to preview its intensity trace.

steps.title: Choose the output folder
steps.text: Leave it empty and the tool creates a folder next to the first input file; after processing the field shows the folder that was used.

steps.title: Check the preview
steps.text: The intensity trace of the selected file with the window boundaries. Check that the duration resolves what you are after before processing.

steps.title: Process
steps.text: Writes one .bst file per input with the inclusive start and stop photon of every window. The processing log lists the windows per file.
